messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: How can I plot ROC for SSCG data?
parts:
Hi Shadrack,

What you're trying to do doesn't make sense for the method. The spatial shrunken centroids method uses ALL of the masses to predict the segments, so there is no way to get the accuracy for only a specific mass.

Printing the summary of cross-validated results will print the specificity and sensitivity for the fitted model. And ranking the m/z values by t-statistic using the topLabels method will show the order of importance of each mass for distinguishing each segment.

The latter may be closest to what you want, if you're trying to find the importance of each mass in distinguishing a particular segment from the others.

-Kylie
